source.note: Official main commit ae163997 (Prologue PR #140 on top of PR #139 ba7e4942 and PR #138 cfb842e4): security & harness audit hardening (P0-1 ui-control destination deny/ask tightening with origin propagation; P1-A1 synchronous shutdown admission latch and retryable pre-drain failure state; P1-A3 Tauri x-goog-api-key header alignment; P1-A4 ScopedStorage commit/commitBatch StorageGuard sync fence routing through commitGuarded; P2-1/P2-2 destructive command and Tauri process executable suffix/path hardening; P2-3 NodeHost reserved bare dispatch storage kind rejection; P2-4 test title alignment) and 0.1.0-rc.2 release bump. No vendor patch.

steps: Extract two independent clean archives from official main commit ae1639977e73f51114e2dd673ddaf1086142629c (Prologue PR #140) via git archive.
Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline, pnpm build, and pnpm -C packages/sdk pack in both clean archives using Node 24.14.0 and pnpm 11.9.0.
Confirm both produced prologue-sdk-0.1.0-rc.2.tgz tarballs are byte-identical via cmp -s and record exact bytes, SHA-256, and SHA-512 integrity.
build.note: Official 0.1.0-rc.2 package incorporating Prologue PR #140 security & harness audit hardening.
